Mitigation for slower clients hard-hanging inside DunGen on oversized interiors (y4ngz313/Y4NGZCompany#446: a 125-tile Alcatras Bunker at DungeonSize 2.4 wedged both clients mid-generation while the host waited forever on floor-generation acks). 0 disables the cap and leaves the scalar exactly as the game and LethalLevelLoader set it - that value is NOT chosen by this mod. When set above 0, the effective DungeonSize (DunGen's LengthMultiplier) is clamped to this value immediately before generation starts, on whichever peer is generating, and the clamp is logged loudly. Around 1.8 is a reasonable starting ceiling; lower it further only if clients still stall.
